meta.name: remix-chatgpt-ad-from-sample
meta.description: Remix a published ChatGPT video ad from the Goose Ads library for a new brand — keep the source's conversation structure and pacing (the single ask → streamed answer beat), swap in the brand's product as the natural recommendation and the promo code woven into the response, get the conversation approved in-session, then render with create-chatgpt-video-ad and publish the MP4 back to Gooseworks with live stage reporting. The ChatGPT chat-reveal / ask-ChatGPT counterpart to remix-imessage-ad-from-sample; this is what the app's ChatGPT format tab calls.
